title: [Master] - Bug 639548 [Expense Agent] Consolidate country demo data into single W1 app
summary: Expense Agent demo data is consolidated from separate country packages into a single W1 implementation, with country-specific demo data centralized while localization apps retain only integration hooks.
key_points: Moved demo data setup, master, transactional, and historical data from AT, AU, CA, DE, DK, ES, FR, GB, NZ, US extensions into W1 demo-data app
Centralized G/L accounts, posting groups, categories, per-diem rules, and posted reports with country awareness
Country Expense Agent subscribers now contain only remaining integration hooks, with obsolete code marked for BC30 cleanup
Simplified maintenance by eliminating duplicate implementations across 10+ countries
Updated build configuration, project groups, manifests, and object ID ranges
quote: Consolidates Expense Agent demo data into the W1 demo-data extension instead of maintaining separate implementations and packages for each country.
